selection: Known published positive momentum anomaly, deliberately selected for an educational contrast; not a new discovery or an unbiased factor search.
window_reason: All 90 complete calendar years from the publisher's first month, ending before the repository's existing sealed windows. Fixed before downloading or inspecting return rows; no winning subperiod search.
formula: Mom = 0.5 * (Small High + Big High) - 0.5 * (Small Low + Big Low), sorted on prior months 2 through 12; monthly reconstitution; publisher value-weighted portfolios.
execution_scope: Replay of publisher-constructed monthly long-short factor returns. No stock-level signals, trades, bt engine, PandaAI Run, or investable account reconstruction.
index: I[0]=1; I[t]=I[t-1]*(1+Mom[t]/100-drag_bps/10000). One unit long and one unit short per unit reference capital, 200% gross notional; the index is illustrative and excludes cash/collateral interest.
cost_scope: 0 bps is the published gross factor. 10/25 bps are fixed monthly return deductions for sensitivity, NOT per-trade fees or estimates of executable net performance. Turnover, financing, borrow, market impact and tax are unavailable.
post_publication_scope: Calendar years after the 1993 Jegadeesh-Titman publication; current revised data and a known anomaly, not a clean out-of-sample test or a replication of that paper's exact strategy.
success_rule: The full-period gross geometric annual return is positive; all fixed sensitivity scenarios and the later period remain visible regardless of outcome. This is historical positive evidence, not admission or future-return certification.
publication: Publish derived statistics, annually sampled charts, protocol, code and hashes. Do not bundle or republish the source ZIP or monthly return rows under the software MIT license.
